hook: Pulling the pin like it owes me money.
setting: On the putting green with the hole and flagstick clearly in frame, camera low beside the cup.
action: Mulligan grabs the flagstick and yanks with his whole body; it pops free and he topples backward into a soft plop on the green. Birdie leans over him.
sound: a flagstick rattle, a soft plop, a giggle
judge: Clean pin reversal with a solid pratfall, but a familiar flip.
